name: Persistent Systems Ltd

reported.quote: We achieved a healthy revenue growth of 3.2% quarter-on-quarter and 16.2% year-on-year, delivering USD 436 million in Q4 FY26.
The EBIT margin for the quarter came in at 16.3%, translating to an EBIT growth of 21.4% and 30.4% QoQ and YoY respectively.
FY26 revenue came in at USD 1.65 billion, translating into 17.4% YoY.
The Total Contract Value for the quarter stood at USD 600.8 million, with Total Contract Value of the new bookings coming in at USD 428.9 million.

calls.tone: Confident and optimistic about ongoing growth, AI adoption, and disciplined execution.

reported.quote: We achieved a healthy revenue growth of 4.0% quarter-on-quarter and 17.3% year-on-year, delivering $422.5 million in Q3 of fiscal 2026.
After accounting for this impact, the EBIT for the quarter came in at 14.4%, which translates into a decline of 7.0% quarter-on-quarter and an increase of 19.1% year-on-year in absolute terms.
Profit After Tax for the quarter came in at 11.6%, a decline of 6.8% quarter-on-quarter and an increase of 17.8% year-on-year in absolute terms.
The Total Contract Value for the quarter stood at USD 674.5 million with the Total Contract Value of new bookings coming in at USD 369.1 million.
The Annual Contract Value of bookings for the quarter is USD 501.9 million out of which the ACV from new bookings contributed USD 255.8 million.
At the end of Q3 FY26, our total headcount stood at 26,711, an increase of 487 from the previous quarter.
Trailing Twelve Months attrition this quarter came in at 13.5% compared to 13.8% in the previous quarter.

calls.tone: Confident, optimistic, and focused on growth and margin expansion.

reported.quote: In Q2 FY26, we delivered revenue of $406.2 million, reflecting 4.2% quarter-on-quarter growth and 17.6% year-on-year growth.
Our EBIT margin reached 16.3%, driving 12.7% QoQ and 43.7% YoY growth in absolute terms.
Profit after tax was Rs. 4,714.7 million, a growth of 45.1% year-on-year.
The total contract value for the quarter came in at $609.2 million, with new bookings at $350.8 million in TCV terms.
At the end of Q2 FY26, our total headcount reached 26,224, up 884 from the last quarter.
Utilization stood at 88.2%, down 50 basis points.
Trailing 12-month attrition improved slightly to 13.8% from 13.9%.

promises.statement: We want to be in the 16 to 17% range as an aspirational goal.
promises.quote: Yeah, so from our perspective we have said we want to be in the 16 to 17 % range, that is our aspiration. That will be our endeavour
promises.speaker: Sandeep Kalra, Executive Director and Chief Executive Officer
promises.actual: EBIT margin was 15% in Q2 FY27 (Oct 2026 call)
promises.verdict: Aspirational target range for margins, currently tracking below the goal.

promises.statement: This deal will add roughly about $125 million plus on an annual basis.
promises.quote: So, from this deal perspective, this is a net new deal which will add roughly about $125 million plus on an annual basis and overall for the period of the contract it will be roughly about $650 million plus over 6.5 years.
promises.speaker: Sandeep Kalra - Executive Director and Chief Executive Officer
promises.actual: Deal expected to add $125M+ annually; integration underway
promises.verdict: Long-term revenue contribution promise spanning 6.5 years remains pending.

promises.statement: The large deal will be accretive for revenue and margin from Q2 onwards.
promises.quote: And yes, it will be accretive - revenue & margin from Q2 onwards.
promises.speaker: Sandeep Kalra - Executive Director and Chief Executive Officer
promises.actual: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin dropped to 14.0% from 16.0% in Q1 FY27
promises.verdict: Deal contribution details to margin accretiveness are not granularly segmented in reported numbers.

promises.statement: We are marching towards the $2 billion run rate by FY27 steadily.
promises.quote: the $2 billion by FY27, that's a run rate. We are marching towards it steadily.
promises.speaker: Sandeep Kalra, Executive Director and CEO
promises.actual: Q2 FY27 annualized revenue run rate is ~$2.24 billion (USD 487.6 million in Q2 FY27)
promises.verdict: Company is currently tracking on schedule toward reaching the $2 billion run rate.

promises.statement: Our aspiration for margins continues to be in the 16 to 17% range.
promises.quote: Our aspiration continues to be in the 16 to 17% range.
promises.speaker: Vinit Teredesai, Executive Director and CFO
promises.actual: EBIT margin reported at 15.0% in Q2 FY27 (Oct 2026 call)
promises.verdict: FY27 margin aspiration is currently tracking below the 16-17% target.

promises.statement: Advance confidently towards our aspiration of $2 billion by March 2027.
promises.quote: I am also happy to share that we remain firmly on track, advancing confidently towards our aspiration of $2 billion by March 2027 and laying the foundation of $5 billion by March 2031.
promises.speaker: Sandeep Kalra, Executive Director and CEO
promises.actual: Q2 FY27 quarterly revenue reached USD 487.6 million (~$1.95B run rate)
promises.verdict: On track to reach or exceed the $2 billion run rate target by March 2027.

promises.statement: Effective Tax Rate for FY26 will be in the range of 20% to 24%.
promises.quote: ETR for FY26 will be in the range of 20%-24%.
promises.speaker: Vinit Teredesai, Executive Director and CFO
promises.actual: FY26 PBT was 674+565+617+555 = Rs 2411 cr, PAT was 1865 cr (effective tax rate ~22.6%)
promises.verdict: Effective tax rate of ~22.6% fell within the targeted 20% to 24% range.

promises.statement: We are looking at 100 basis point improvement in FY26, and probably another 100 basis point in FY27.
promises.quote: we are looking at 100 basis point improvement in FY26, and probably another 100 basis point in FY27. That's what we have mentioned.
promises.speaker: Vinit Teredesai - Executive Director and Chief Financial Officer
promises.target: 100 bps improvement in FY26 and 100 bps in FY27
promises.actual: FY26 EBITDA margin improved to 19.0% from 17.0% in FY25 (+200 bps); Q2 FY27 dropped to 14.0%
promises.verdict: Exceeded FY26 margin goal, but FY27 margins declined sharply in recent quarters.

promises.statement: The effective tax rate for FY26 is likely to remain in the range of 22.5% to 23.5%.
promises.quote: As discussed in the previous quarter's earnings call, the effective tax rate for FY26 is likely to remain in the range of 22.5% to 23.5%.
promises.speaker: Vinit Teredesai - Executive Director and Chief Financial Officer
promises.verdict: Effective tax rate landed right within the promised 22.5% to 23.5% range.

deliveredSummary: Persistent delivered strong YoY revenue growth exceeding 30% by Sep 2026, but EBITDA margins collapsed from 19.0% to 14.0%, missing mid-term profitability aspirations.

divergences.story: Management expresses confidence and optimism regarding operational integration and deal accretiveness.
divergences.numbers: EBITDA margin dropped sharply from 19.0% in Mar 2026 to 14.0% in Sep 2026.

divergences.story: Management maintained optimistic tone around tool-driven margin expansion and disciplined execution.
divergences.numbers: Net profit fell 25.3% YoY in Sep 2026 to Rs 352 crore.

bull: Revenue YoY growth accelerated to 30.2% in Sep 2026, reaching Rs 4,664 crore.
Cumulative cash conversion (CFO/PAT) remains strong at 101% over the historical period.
Quarterly USD revenue reached $487.6M in Q2 FY27, making $2B run-rate highly achievable.
bear: EBITDA margins plunged 500 bps from 19.0% in Mar 2026 to 14.0% in Sep 2026.
Net profit contracted 25.3% YoY in Sep 2026 to Rs 352 crore.
Cash conversion cycle elongated significantly from 62 days in FY24 to 83 days in FY26.
business: Persistent Systems delivers software engineering and strategy services, offering proprietary software frameworks with pre-built integration alongside key technology partnerships such as Salesforce and AWS.

threads.note: Target maintained across calls; revenue reached USD 487.6 million in Q2 FY27, tracking ahead of goal.
Aspirational target held at 16-17%, though reported Q2 FY27 EBIT margin dropped to 15%.
Target broadened slightly from 22.5-23.5% to 20-24%; delivered at ~22.6% for FY26.
